text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW and basophils, mild hypoglycemia, elevated creatinine, low CO₂, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, and INR. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic inflammatory/infectious process, impaired oxygenation, and possible renal dysfunction. The elevated D-dimer and INR may indicate increased thrombotic risk. Correlation with clinical findings and further evaluation are recommended.
